evals.prompt: can this machine run claude inside the MXC sandbox? check it for me
evals.expected_output: Resolves scripts/mxc.ps1 from the skill base dir, checks the dotnet SDK and claude.exe, runs `mxc.ps1 probe --workspace <dir>`, reports tier (BaseContainer), isolationSession availability, and the exact grant lines, then runs a PONG smoke test

evals.prompt: set up mxc so I can test plugins in it, and show me what the sandbox will be able to see
evals.expected_output: Probes with and without --allow-win32k against an explicit workspace, lists read-only and read-write grants, and notes that --allow-win32k makes all folder names listable while contents stay denied

evals.prompt: the mxc probe says AppContainer tier instead of BaseContainer, what now?
evals.expected_output: Explains that this tier needs wxc-host-prep prepare-system-drive once and prepare-null-device after every boot, elevated; states the user must run them and does not attempt elevation

evals.prompt: I updated the mxc-sandbox plugin, rebuild the MXC host
evals.expected_output: Runs `& $mxc -Rebuild probe` with -Rebuild as the first argument and confirms the 'building host' line and tier

evals.prompt: turn on Claude Code's built-in sandbox mode for bash commands
